en: Old monochrome postcard with a central photograph of a historic city gate and surrounding buildings on a sloping street. At the top is the printed caption "Kamenita vrata." The bottom margin has printed text and handwritten cursive writing, and more handwriting fills the right side. A round postal cancellation stamp on the upper left reads "KRAPINA 98 SEP 10." The photograph shows Stone Gate with houses closely built along the street and trees on the right.
